test_title: PYST 71: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: What is the primary focus of the National Mission on Edible Oils-Oil Palm (NMEO-OP)?

options.text: Promoting cultivation of a tropical oil-rich crop

solution:
The correct answer is __**Promoting cultivation of a tropical oil-rich crop**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Mission on Edible Oils-Oil Palm (NMEO-OP)** is a **Centrally Sponsored Scheme** launched by the Government of India in **August 2021** to transform the edible oil sector.
 
• The primary objective of this mission is to significantly increase the domestic production of **Crude Palm Oil (CPO)** by promoting the cultivation of **Oil Palm**, which is a highly productive **tropical oil-rich crop**.
 
• The mission targets expanding the area under oil palm cultivation to **10 lakh hectares** by **2025-26** and further to **16.7 lakh hectares** by **2029-30**, focusing heavily on the **North-Eastern states** and the **Andaman and Nicobar Islands**.
 
• With a total financial outlay of **Rs. 11,040 crore**, the initiative aims to reduce India's heavy reliance on edible oil imports, which currently account for nearly **60%** of the total domestic consumption.
 
• The scheme provides **financial assistance** to farmers for planting material and maintenance, while also establishing a **Viability Price** mechanism to protect farmers from the volatility of international CPO prices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Oil Palm Characteristics:**

 
 
• It is a perennial **tropical crop** that yields much higher quantities of oil per unit of land compared to traditional oilseeds like **mustard**, **groundnut**, or **soybean**.
 
• A single hectare of oil palm can produce approximately **4 tonnes of oil**, which is about **10 to 46 times** more productive than other oilseed crops.
 
 
 
• **Economic Significance:**
 
 
• India is the **world's largest importer** of edible oils, spending a massive amount of foreign exchange annually on imports primarily from **Indonesia** and **Malaysia**.
 
• The mission is a key component of the **Atmanirbhar Bharat** (Self-reliant India) initiative, aiming to achieve self-sufficiency in **vegetable oils** and enhance the income of **Indian farmers**.
